title_zh: 哈利法港：阿布扎比的现代化港口
title_en: China's Ports (18/20): Khalifa Port, Abu Dhabi's Modern Harbor
note_en: The frame 通过……减少对……的依赖 combines means and goal: 通过发展港口和物流产业，减少经济对石油的依赖 "reduce the economy's dependence on oil by developing ports and logistics." Where English puts "by ...ing" after the main verb, Chinese puts 通过 ("by means of") first; and "dependence on X" becomes 对X的依赖, with 对 marking what one depends on and 的 linking it to the noun 依赖.
